finlex.name: Finlex: Finnish legislation in Finnish and Swedish
finlex.useFor: Legal terms. Laws are official in both languages, so the Swedish text of e.g. the Act on Residential Leases (481/1995) and the Limited Liability Housing Companies Act (1599/2009) settles Finland-Swedish terms.

finlex_en.name: Finlex: unofficial English translations of Finnish legislation
finlex_en.useFor: English legal terms. The translations are unofficial, so they support a choice but don't settle it.

fsob.name: Finlandssvensk ordbok (Institutet för de inhemska språken)
fsob.useFor: Where Finland-Swedish differs from Sweden's Swedish: which words are Finland-Swedish, which are Sweden-only, and which are finlandisms to avoid.

iate.name: IATE, the EU's terminology database
iate.useFor: Cross-checking equivalents between the three languages. Its Swedish is often Sweden's, so check Finland-Swedish usage elsewhere.

kielitoimisto.name: Kielitoimiston sanakirja
kielitoimisto.useFor: Finnish meaning, spelling and inflection, for the match patterns.

svenska_se.name: Svenska.se (Svenska Akademiens ordböcker)
svenska_se.useFor: Swedish spelling and inflection, for the match patterns. It describes Sweden's Swedish; Finland-Swedish legal and tax terms come from Finlex and the Tax Administration.

tepa.name: TEPA term bank (Sanastokeskus)
tepa.useFor: Special-field terms with definitions in Finnish, Swedish and English, including economics and housing.

valter.name: Valter, the Finnish Government's term bank
valter.useFor: How the Government translates administrative and legislative terms, e.g. agency names and the glossary of legislative terms.

vero_en.name: Finnish Tax Administration, English pages
vero_en.useFor: English tax terms as the Tax Administration uses them.

vero_fi.name: Verohallinto
vero_fi.useFor: Finnish tax terms: rental income, deductible expenses, form 7H.

vero_sv.name: Skatteförvaltningen, svenska sidor
vero_sv.useFor: Finland-Swedish tax terms, including the Swedish form 7H.
